author.bio: Host My Nest is a boutique London short-let management company helping owners maximise revenue while staying fully compliant with London's evolving regulatory framework. We manage properties across central and west London on a transparent 15% fee — well below the industry standard — combining hands-on local operations with data-driven pricing and multi-platform distribution.
